cover.kicker: 封面故事 · GitHub 项目
cover.title:
rea 热度回落
衍生项目却在变多
cover.dek: rea 单日新增从 17,573 降到 5,147,仍是榜首。围绕它长出了资源清单、防御工具和游戏逆向 skill,值得看看热度之后留下了什么。
cover.title_en:
rea is cooling off,
but its offshoots keep multiplying
cover.dek_en: Daily gains for rea fell from 17,573 to 5,147, and it still leads the chart. Around it have grown awesome lists, a defensive tool and game reverse-engineering skills.

stickers.title: 插件平台
stickers.text: deepseek-harness 日增 +949,7 日均值连续 19 天不低于 666,dsh-plugin 项目越来越多。
stickers.text_en: deepseek-harness gained +949 stars today, with its 7-day average at 666 or higher for 19 days straight.

stickers.title: 安全警报
stickers.text: 官方 Claude Code VS Code 扩展 2.1.313 在 Cursor 市场被植入后门,HN 三条帖子高分。
stickers.text_en: Claude Code's VS Code extension 2.1.313 was backdoored on the Cursor marketplace. Three HN threads scored 641, 393 and 235.

stickers.title: 论文角
stickers.text: 有论文扫描了 153 万个 skill,另一篇专门评估 skill 扫描器的覆盖率。
stickers.text_en: One paper scanned 1.53 million skills, and another tests how much of that ground skill scanners cover.
